_comment: Sizes (px) derive from build/icons/icon.png by scripts/generate-app-icons.js. The master is rendered from build/icons/app-icon.svg: the LANA One mark (two corner brackets and a 1) in dark ink on a white macOS-style rounded tile with a faint edge. Sources and the dark-tile variant are in build/brand/lana-one. The 16/32/48/64/128/256 PNGs are folded into icon.ico on Windows.
